test_cases.title: Return actions within the date range with all fields
preconditions: Issuer ISS-6001 has actions on 2024-02-10, 2024-06-15 and 2025-01-20
test_cases.expected_result: Returns the 2024-06-15 and 2024-02-10 actions; each has action_id, action_type, agency, previous_rating, new_rating, notch_change, effective_date, analyst_id, recorded_at.

test_cases.title: Both range dates are inclusive
test_cases.expected_result: The first query returns the 2024-03-31 and 2024-03-01 actions only. The single-day query returns only 2024-03-01.

test_cases.title: Sort by effective_date desc, then recorded_at desc
preconditions: Issuer ISS-6003 has two actions effective 2024-05-01 (recorded 09:00 and 15:00) and one effective 2024-06-01

test_cases.title: Accept exactly 10 years, reject 10 years plus one day

test_cases.title: Known issuer with no actions in range returns an empty list
preconditions: Issuer ISS-6001 has no actions in 2020
test_cases.expected_result: Returns an empty list and no error.

steps: Query history covering the action date
test_cases.expected_result: Both ACT-1 and the CORRECTION record are returned; the CORRECTION references ACT-1; ACT-1 is unchanged.

test_cases.expected_result: Both attempts are rejected; ACT-1 is unchanged and still returned.
